scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run check:shared-boundary && npm run build -w web && npm run build:info
scripts.test: npm run check:shared-boundary && npm run lint -w @university-homework/domain && npm run test -w server && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:tools
scripts.test:frontend: npm run lint -w web && npm run format:check -w web && npm run test -w web
scripts.verify: npm run build -w web && npm run build --prefix desktop
